description.value: Browns Crafthouse on Main Street is a full-service kitchen and bar operated by Browns Restaurant Group, a BC-based multi-location chain with outlets from Fort St. John to Victoria. Situated at the intersection of Main Street and East 16th Avenue in Vancouver, it offers a sit-down dining experience spanning a full food menu, weekend brunch, and a dedicated beer menu. For a touring cyclist passing through Vancouver's Main Street corridor, it offers a substantial mid-ride or end-of-day meal option in a neighbourhood setting.
